reviews.classification: partial actual mechanism/UI crosswalk review; retain investigation and implementation boundaries
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual new review covers original221–300: ENGINE_EXPANSION EI3–EI32, UIE1–UIE26 and their named execution candidates/P1–P5, plus genetics MT1–MT7/LD1–LD2. Together B534–B536 cover original1–300 only. Original301–1169 and the final appended tranche notes still need cumulative full-coverage accounting. Source-local EI/UIE/MT/LD/P labels retain their supplier identity rather than becoming global engine codes.

F2: EI3–EI14 preserve real functional quantities, scope, aggregation, source/target instance and local law. A capability score/tag is not a causal temperature/light/permission field. Path, reach, contact, location and jurisdiction differ. Existing pure capability queries, effect branches and phased jobs are useful seams, not proof of every target kind or a mandate for continuous coordinates, ECS or a universal DSL. Timed refund contracts do not automatically implement irreversible work, maintained fields or partial channel aftermath. Existing positive paid-energy policy is not a universal fee for free/non-energy powers. Frozen paid commitments retain their chosen policy rather than silently recomputing at every context change. Technical continuation budgets preserve strong valid synergies and do not become lore limits.

F3: EI15–EI32 preserve phase distinctions: preview, commitment, settlement and observation; durability before model publication; post-commit render failures outside rollback; scoped definition/instance changes; observer-safe explanation separate from physical truth; caching only dependencies actually read; author support and real consumers. Registration, catalogued content, pure executable behavior and native integration are different states. A selected stat/source should affect all applicable readers without flattening local combat rules. Two independently constructed/disposed instances are a meaningful isolation check, not evidence every singleton was converted. Stable thing/lot/body identity guards an identically named replacement, with split/merge only where the chosen domain needs it. Matching segmented time includes expiry, choices and unspent remainder. Scenario facade/headless existence reviewed in B532 is later evidence beyond the old proposal, not whole-game or real-browser parity. AD51 qualifies old second-case prerequisites; AD36/AR10 retain relevant integrated proof.

F4: UIE1/UIE13–UIE16 describe an M3 investigation, not a confirmed current bug. Paused setup could legitimately retain read-only/restore-saving state; diagnose ownership/restoration before adding refresh or forcing writability. UIE16 explicitly says ready was included in both view and quote at that snapshot, so its future missing-dependency example is preventive. Keep native reasons and one deferred publication/open refresh owner, with no extra gameplay tick required merely to inspect. Stable subject/control IDs matter when nodes reorder, not only restoring an old index. Current desktop targets supersede copied1366 requirements. The source-only blocked label does not establish a present external blocker or a new mandatory full suite per row.

F5: UIE17–UIE26 preserve the later corrections inside the copied table: factory-panel API around a stateless renderer; separate preview page/bundle rather than main.js instrumentation; observer-safe read() captures or synthetic fixtures for raw-state panels; first real view outside M3 ownership; conversion governed by import closure. A fixture's real pixels are not gameplay settlement, native startup, storage proof or installed geometry. A pinned compiled adapter remains transitional, not a durable public API. Approximate effort fractions and copied model/reservation recipes are historical proposals. Preview, input, layout and preference lifecycles cannot consume stock, reroll or silently apply draft commands; genuine command controls keep real guards. No automatic archive-wide preview migration follows.

F6: Genetics MT preserves shared modifier ownership, correctly scoped body time, selected offline policy, save decisions, stable card identity, observer projection and comfort settings. It does not mandate one scalar clock across bodies/worlds or make every body fact heritable. LD1's private read-only truth-versus-observer inspector is development evidence, not a public disclosure surface; LD2 fixture scenarios do not become naturally earned body histories. B512's complete genetics reconciliation and B532/B533's complete engine/UI owners qualify these old crosswalk constraints without replacing their detailed suppliers. This tranche reviews content only; no source, actor, save, UI, model, world law, implementation or verification gate was changed.
reviews.evidence: Actual original221–260 read; dense truncated middle recovered231–245 and246–250. Original261–280 and281–300 read completely in bounded outputs. B534/B535 cover1–220;301–1169 not credited. No underlying supplier source, private truth, screenshot or runtime rerun.
